features: DISPLAY: Lose yourself in a 11-inch (27.81 CM) Dynamic AMOLED 2X touch display. COLOR & DESIGN: 8GB RAM + 128GB Storage, Wifi Only Tablet

RAM & STORAGE: With up to 12GB of memory and 256GB of storage, it enables fast, seamless multitasking and support for large files. If needed, you can even expand storage up to 1TB with a microSD card.
CONNECTIVITY: Wi-Fi 6E and Bluetooth 5.3 keep you latency-free in competitive lobbies; USB 3.2 for rapid file transfers. UNIQUE FEATURE: S Pen Included
SPEAKERS & AUDIO: Quad Stereo Speakers with Dolby Atmos, High-bitrate audio support

AI CAPABILITIES: Experience Circle to Search with Google and search like never before. Simply circle around an object to get Google Search results. It’s a new visual way to find what you're looking for. Search like never before with Circle to Search thanks to Google.
